import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from parser import parse
for line, exp in [("key=value", ("key", "value")), ("a=1", ("a", "1")), ("PATH=/usr/bin", ("PATH", "/usr/bin")),
                  ("x_y=hello world", ("x_y", "hello world")), ("name=alice", ("name", "alice"))]:
    r = parse(line)
    if tuple(r) != exp or len(r) != 2 or not all(type(v) is str for v in r):
        sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)

note: robustness for bad input is open-ended; checks well-formed key=value lines still parse to the same (str, str) pair
